title: Triangle Glyph Lab
claim: Tests the triangle as an eight-locus relational glyph: three vertices, three edges, one interior, and one outside/context.
mechanisms: shareable URL state and JSON export
formal_boundary: Inspired by relational triangle notation and distinction/marked-space ideas; not an implementation or extension of Laws of Form.
known_limits: No claim that eight loci form a complete grammar.
Marks are interface annotations, not Spencer-Brown primary algebra operations.
Compact notation is experimental and not canonical.
POWER preset only solves simple real-valued one-unknown demonstrations.

disposition.note: 8-locus grammar and compact/share mechanics transferred into unified Triangle 1.0; standalone lab retained for regression/provenance.
